task.task_need: Return exact DOI-matched Europe PMC fullTextUrlList metadata without downloading or inspecting article content.

candidate_invocation.query_mode: DOI:<exact caller-supplied DOI>; format=json; resultType=core; pageSize=5

comparison.finding: Both calls returned the same Europe PMC MED record identity for the exact DOI. The existing lite metadata search did not return fullTextUrlList; the new core query returned three provider-reported locations. The new adapter supplies a distinct exact-DOI location output and does not replace topic-to-record discovery.
comparison.retained_unique_use_case: For a known DOI, inspect a bounded provider-reported Europe PMC fullTextUrlList projection while keeping the actual article URLs untouched.
not_established: URL availability or successful article access

required_outputs: Input-ordered per-DOI acquisition and exact-match state, provider hit count, and at most five exact DOI-matched provider records.
